query: Which pre-specified robustness checks for top incomes, imputation methods, equivalence scales, and survey design will we run and how will we report uncertainty (bootstrap or posterior intervals)?

response.query: Which pre-specified robustness checks for top incomes, imputation methods, equivalence scales, and survey design will we run and how will we report uncertainty (bootstrap or posterior intervals)?
response.answer: We will run sensitivity analyses for top incomes, use multiple imputation methods, apply different equivalence scales, and adjust for survey design. Uncertainty will be reported using bootstrap intervals.
